title: SHOVEL
subtitle: Table hockey · right wing to centre · far corner
end_steps: CENTRE GIVES WAY, PUCK ON ITS BACK
SHOVEL UP THE SLOT, FAR CORNER

setup.title: THE SET-UP
setup.text: The right wing stands back to the goal with the puck behind its blade. The centre waits at the bottom of its slot, also back to the goal.

beats.title: THE PASS
beats.text: The right wing turns counter-clockwise. The back of the blade pushes the puck across to the centre: a push, not a strike.
beats.label: PASS · BACKHAND PUSH

beats.title: THE SHOVEL
beats.text: The centre steps up to meet the pass and turns with it, so the puck lands softly on the back of its skates. Then it runs up the slot and pushes the puck into the far corner.
beats.label: SHOVEL · BACK OF THE SKATES
